title: refactor(types,components): one authority each for FilterBuilderCondition, FilterGroup and FilterBuilderOperator (objectui#6349, batch 12)
body:
Refs #6349 (batch 12)
Clause-②: yes

This converges the last three Filter rows of the one-authority ledger (`KNOWN_COLLISIONS`). The decision is the seat's claim amendment `6118165522` on objectui#6349: A on each row, read against the objectui#9306 ruling (`5852274286`, `5857342228`), which makes `@object-ui/types` the single name authority for the builder's row and group. The measurements behind it are in round 1's report (`6118141319`). After this PR, the ledger keeps one row, `CalendarEvent` (objectui#5044's ruled shim).

## What changes

- **`FilterBuilderCondition`: components' derived row is renamed `FilterBuilderRow`.** It still derives from `@object-ui/types`' `FilterBuilderCondition` and restates only the two ruled extensions: `operator` is components' `FilterBuilderOperator`, and `value` is required and narrowed. The shape is unchanged. Under the authority's name, the derived row was a second authority whose shape is assignable to types' in neither direction.
- **`FilterGroup`: components' derived group is renamed `FilterBuilderRowGroup`.** Its three shipped readers re-point:
  - plugin-list `ListView.tsx` (the published `ListViewProps.onFilterChange` and `initialFilters`);
  - plugin-view `config/view-config-utils.ts` (the published `toFilterGroup` return type);
  - app-shell `views/userFilterUrlState.ts`.
  Their four tests re-point too.
- **`FilterBuilderOperator`: types' declaration retires.** It was the spec's `ViewFilterOperator` under a second name, and nothing read it through the types entry.
  - The authored row now types `operator` with the spec's name, the same set as before.
  - `data-protocol.ts` imports the spec's `ViewFilterOperator` as `BaseFilterOperator`.
  - The root barrel drops the name.
  - components' `FilterBuilderOperator` (the protocol ids plus the opt-in `exists` / `notExists`) keeps its name, as the ruling says.
- **Ledger:** the three rows go, each with a comment in the style of the earlier batches.
- **Pins and prose:**
  - Each of the 8415 and 6939 source-text pins had one test that reads the renamed text, and those tests move with the rename.
  - The 9559 test pins the row's `operator` member and the absence of the retired name.
  - components' name-authority test pins that the old names are not published from the builder module.
  - The prose that named the renamed or retired declarations is updated in `complex.ts`, `complex.zod.ts`, `packages/components/docs/FilterBuilder.md` and plugin-view's README line.
  - The `complex.zod.ts` sentence that said the component declares `id` as a string is corrected.
  - `FilterBuilder.md` no longer calls the group `id` required, and it lists the canonical operator ids instead of the retired camelCase aliases.

No runtime behaviour changes: the emitted JS is identical, as measured below.

## Changesets

- `@object-ui/components` `minor`. Breaking note: `FilterBuilderCondition` and `FilterGroup` leave the root. Use `FilterBuilderRow` (the old import gives TS2305) and `FilterBuilderRowGroup` (the old import gives TS2724, whose "Did you mean 'ItemGroup'?" points at an unrelated component, so the note names the replacement).
- `@object-ui/types` `minor`. Breaking note: `FilterBuilderOperator` leaves the root. Import `ViewFilterOperator` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/plugin-view` and `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`. Their shapes do not move; only the referenced name does.

## Evidence

Every gate below ran on head `9330f85`: the two commits plus a merge of `main` at `d928c83` (objectui#12183, app-shell `metadata-admin` only, no overlap). Base is `7e30d0b`, built in a separate detached worktree.

**Built-entry names, one TypeScript program over each built entry:**

| root | base | head |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@object-ui/types` | 709 | 708 |
| `@object-ui/components` | 419 | 419 |
| `@object-ui/plugin-list` | 19 | 19 |
| `@object-ui/plugin-view` | 39 | 39 |
| `@object-ui/app-shell` | 259 | 259 |

- At head, components publishes `FilterBuilderRow`, `FilterBuilderRowGroup` and `FilterBuilderOperator`, and neither old name.
- types publishes `FilterBuilderCondition` and `FilterGroup`, and not `FilterBuilderOperator`.

**Equal shapes, base built entry against head built entry:**
- `@object-ui/components`: 419 claims, one per exported name, with the two renames mapped. 0 errors.
- `@object-ui/types`: 716 claims, one per exported name except the retired one. 715 hold. The one that does not is `INFLIGHT_GET_REGISTRY_KEY`, a `unique symbol` that is never identical across two declarations; its declaration file is byte-identical, so that failure is the instrument's limit, not a change.
- plugin-list, plugin-view and app-shell: their changed `.d.ts` files are identical to base, comments removed, once the one renamed identifier is substituted, and a control without the substitution differs. Cross-worktree Equal claims could not judge these three: TypeScript deduplicates the two same-version `@object-ui/components` copies into one program.

**Emitted JS, every rebuilt package, base dist against head dist:**
- components 0 JS files differ (1 file in all: `custom/filter-builder.d.ts`). plugin-list 0. plugin-view 0.
- types: 2 JS files differ (`zod/complex.zod.js`, `zod/index.zod.js`), and both are identical once comments are removed. The other `.d.ts` differences are union-member reordering from declaration emit.
- app-shell: `views/userFilterUrlState.js` is identical once comments are removed. The other 5 differing JS files are the sources objectui#12183 changed, merged from `main`.

**Ablation legs** ran through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: each anchor hit as declared, and each restore was proven blob-equal to `HEAD` with an empty `git diff HEAD`. The control gate shows 11 passed. Each leg is red and names its row:

| row | row put back in the ledger | name declared again |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `FilterBuilderCondition` | gate 1 failed / 10 passed, "no longer collides" | gate 1 failed ("a NEW colliding name"); 8415 pin 1 failed; components' test program TS2578 on the old-row pin |
| `FilterGroup` | gate 1 failed, "no longer collides" | gate 1 failed ("a NEW colliding name"); components' test program TS2578 on the old-group pin |
| `FilterBuilderOperator` | gate 1 failed, "no longer collides" | gate 1 failed ("a NEW colliding name"), declared in types' `complex.ts` |

**Gates:**
- Build: `turbo run build` over the closures of app-shell, plugin-list and plugin-view (29 tasks), and the doc-snippet build filter (35 tasks), all successful.
- `type-check` (each package's own script, both or all three programs): types, components, plugin-list, plugin-view and app-shell, each exit 0.
- `type-check:scripts`: exit 0. eslint over the 19 touched TypeScript files: 0 errors, and the same warning count as base.
- Targeted vitest over 59 files beside the touched sites: the ledger test, every filter-builder test in components, types and examples, plugin-list's and app-shell's filter tests, and the tests that read `complex.ts` or `data-protocol.ts`. Test Files 59 passed (59), Tests 1468 passed (1468).
- `check:readme-exports`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:doc-snippets`: OK.
- `check-changeset-presence` (5 changesets for 5 released packages), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals` and `check-changeset-fixed`: OK.
- `check:control-bytes`: OK. `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations. The governed-queue guard reads NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- The first full readme-exports and doc-snippets runs were PREREQUISITE NOT MET: six untouched packages were unbuilt. Both are green after the gates' own build filter ran, and the first runs are not counted.
- Round 1's first types-retire probe measured nothing, and is not counted: ablation-replace refused a replacement that was a substring of its anchor.
- Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed on the final head before the queue (`Clause-②: yes`).
